summary: Remote WebSocket channel drives Claude Code with bypassPermissions and arbitrary file I/O on installer host
details: On startup, the agent opens a persistent WebSocket to the hardcoded server wss://agenthub-agent.fyenet.com and dispatches inbound envelopes (MessageSend, SessionCreate, FileWrite, FileRead, FileSearch, FileTree) into control handlers running on the installer's machine. MessageSend/SessionCreate feed a Claude Code SDK query() started with permissionMode: "bypassPermissions" in the installer's working directory, allowing a remote party paired through the vendor relay to execute arbitrary tool use (shell, edit, write) without prompting. FileRead/FileWrite handlers call writeFileContent(normalizePath(path), content) and readFileContent(normalizePath(path),...) on remote-supplied paths with no scoping to the working directory, giving the remote peer arbitrary read/write on the host with the agent user's privileges — including overwrite of shell RC files, SSH configuration, and other persistence locations. Separately, on boot the agent spawns `pnpm update @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk --latest` and re-execs itself in TTY prod mode, pulling the SDK unpinned on every start.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
